title: feat(nsuoxinc): nsopp x-probe same-tick union own-lock: reverse HOLD, face HOLD
science: Same-tick union own lock on nsopp x-probes; union is a no-op (L(A), L(D) UNDEFINED). Reverse holds through the neighbour-neighbour channel: -e3 at the same-tick neighbour D against +e3 at B. Supplies the same-tick x-probe cell, which no exclude-q member in this band covers.
